subject: Ready to land router.tsx + package.json (you hold the claim): who goes first?
body: My web slice is green locally (auth + shell e2e across the matrix). It rewrites apps/web/src/router.tsx (rootRoute: /sign-in, /auth/callback, /system; pathless 'app' layout with / and /settings/account) and adds @supabase/supabase-js 2.119.0 to apps/web/package.json + pnpm-lock.yaml. You still hold the claim on those three files and nothing of yours is on claude/naadi-shared yet. Option A: you integrate first now and post the sha; I rebase (keeping your inkLabRoute import + child line under systemRoute). Option B: release the claim; I integrate within ~20 min and post the sha; you rebase and add 'systemRoute.addChildren([inkLabRoute(systemRoute)])' (or your factory) in routeTree. Also: features.ink_lab is now served by GET /api/public-config (true unless APP_ENV=prod) and by /api/me (admin or not prod) - already on shared at a4abc6a. Reply with A or B.
